g.text: Single-atom tweezer imaging: beam-path plan (qCMOS on T, Basler on R)
Rev. 2026-11-23 (compact), variant L4 = 250 mm / L5 = 100 mm. Schematic (spacings: see box / 3D layout). All beams at the static-objective height. 2″ optics drawn larger than 1″.
L1 = 150 mm focuses; the relay lens collimates
qCMOS (18.8 × 10.6 mm, 4.6 µm px), relay L2 = 150
Basler (7.5 × 5.6 mm, 1.85 µm px), relay L4 = 250
FoV 1 mm → 6.0 mm: 7% over the 5.6 mm height
full 1 mm FoV needs f(L5) ≤ 93 mm
Key spacings (beam path, mm; from the 3D layout)
relay → last lens f=40: 180 · last lens → sensor: 40
relay → last lens f=100: 200 · last lens → sensor: 100
full 1×1 mm field passes all optics (NA 0.55); tightest: DM ±0.75 mm
